	<ResortReportHeadline>Magic Monday!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>Yet another magic day on the mountain coming up.&nbsp; &nbsp;The sky is clear and there is just a puff of a breeze from the southeast.&nbsp; The current temp is right on zero and we are heading for a balmy top of 7 degrees.&nbsp;</p><p>The snow has had another good freeze overnight, so will start the day off firm before the sunny aspects soften for fun spring-like turns.&nbsp; There should be good turns to be had on the groomers from the get-go, and some off-piste areas will be worth a look once the day warms.&nbsp; Just beware of shaded and south facing slopes that may stay slick for the day.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Slap on the screen and follow the sun for fun turns all day!</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>

Take care out there.  </Backcountry>
